reviews.review_title: The best model painting game you’ll find
reviews.review_description: This game is the best model painting game you’ll find, it has very good replay ability and there’s a lot of models to choose from so it doesn’t get boring easy, my only problem is it’s sometimes tedious to get into the cracks and crevices of some of the models but overall if this game was 20 euro I would still buy it, overall very good game. Kudos to the game developers👍

I've always wanted to try painting minifigs, so this game is great for practice or inspiration, I've done two so far and can't wait to do more. Though I thought it was odd they got rid of the trash can, other than that perfect game
I just got it after the free trail, PEAK great if you play war hammer games or games like that to practice
